mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT activity.id, activity."name", activity.category, activity.venue, "session".status, CASE WHEN activity_image.activity_uuid IS NOT NULL THEN '/v1/activity/activityImage/' || activity.id END AS image_url FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" activity INNER JOIN "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" ON activity.id = "session".activity_id LEFT JOIN "interviewworks_ticket".seat seat ON activity.id = seat.activity_id LEFT JOIN "interviewworks_ticket".activity_image activity_image ON activity.activity_uuid = activity_image.activity_uuid ORDER BY activity.id

SELECT image.image_data FROM "interviewworks_ticket".activity_image image JOIN "interviewworks_ticket".activity activity ON activity.activity_uuid = image.activity_uuid WHERE activity.id = #{activityId}
SELECT activity_id FROM interviewworks_ticket.activity_favorite WHERE user_email = #{email} ORDER BY created_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interviewworks_ticket.activity_favorite (user_email, activity_id) VALUES (#{email}, #{activity_id}) ON CONFLICT (user_email, activity_id) DO NOTHING
